# KinemIQ Free Game Animations (CC0)

35 humanoid game animations as FBX and GLB on one skeleton (66 bones, 30 fps), plus a mannequin character:
idles, walks, runs, sprint, crouch, jump (take-off, air, landing), roll, punches (jab, cross, hook), hit reactions,
a death, get up, sit down / stand up, a dance, climb, pick up, sword slash / idle / block.

- `KinemIQ_Free_Animations_CC0_FBX.zip` – FBX (Unity Humanoid, Unreal Engine, Blender)
- `KinemIQ_Free_Animations_CC0_GLB.zip` – GLB / glTF (Godot, three.js, Blender)

## Licence
CC0 1.0 – free for any use, also commercial, no credit required. Source: Universal Animation Library by Quaternius
(CC0 1.0); retargeted, cleaned up and exported by KinemIQ.

## More
